scope: Theorem 11.9 (A fixed strip with half-line history) of the manuscript “Incompressible Box Transport and Finite Computation” (preprints/Incompressible-Box-Transport-and-Finite-Computation-October-6-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 376 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2505dc09d3f2c24b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 48. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: On T3, the fixed label (1/8, 1/4, 1/4) and strip 2/3 < x1 < 15/16 realize halting by a general mean-zero force, with zero initial velocity and pressure, bounded mixed derivatives and period one after time one. For a fixed machine only the loading field depends on the input. The material maps are volume-preserving diffeomorphisms, and the velocity and material-acceleration identities of Lemma 2.2 hold.
